adopt: Ask one typed question of one state and read back a decision, a probability, and decided=False when nothing earned it.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Software makes the same bounded decision millions of times and asks a text model each time, then parses prose. Hosted "decision models" fix the shape but send the program state off-box, emit a probability that is never resolved against what happened, and cannot say what happens next if you act on it. A decision is a function; the loop it sits in is the product.

Install
pip install awdecide
synopsis: One typed-decision contract -- choice / score / bool with a probability -- over a ladder of backends you already run (rules, tiny local models, an LLM's logprobs), fail-closed, with a Brier ledger that resolves every decision against its outcome.
